stem:
The time, $X$ hours, taken by a large number of runners to complete a race is modelled by the probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{k}{(x+1)^2} & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant a, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ and $a$ are constants.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State what the constant $a$ represents in this context.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.stem: Three quarters of the runners take half an hour or less to complete the race.
